why: The chain regenerates committed artifacts against NDI-matlab and DID-matlab. Their refs move without any change here (NDI origin/main gained .m files twice on 2026-10-23), so the chain builds and checks against these exact commits. Moving them is a deliberate commit (tools/sibling_lock.py --update). Decided by Jess Haley, 2026-10-23, in conversation. NDIcalc-vis-matlab joins the lock at the commit the tuning templates are read from (Jess Haley's decision of 2026-10-27, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [lock NDIcalc-vis-matlab]); it has no V2 line, so its head and main are the same commit.
